description: Chart and graph selection guidance. This catalog recommends visual encodings; it does not claim to render charts.

bar.label: Bar chart
bar.when: Compare values across a manageable set of categories; use horizontal bars for long labels.
bar.avoid: Many categories, dense time series, or comparing unrelated units.
bar.encoding: Position on a common quantitative axis.
bar.accessibility: Start at zero for magnitude comparisons; sort intentionally; label units and values.

line.label: Line chart
line.when: Show change over ordered time with consistent intervals.
line.avoid: Unordered categories or too many overlapping series.
line.encoding: Position over time; connected points imply continuity.
line.accessibility: Label series directly, use distinct dash patterns or markers, and expose exact values.

area.label: Area chart
area.when: Show cumulative magnitude or part-to-whole change over time.
area.avoid: Comparing many overlapping series or precise small differences.
area.accessibility: Prefer small series counts; explain stacking and baseline.

stacked_bar.label: Stacked bar chart
stacked_bar.when: Compare composition across a small number of categories.
stacked_bar.avoid: Precise comparison of middle segments across bars.
stacked_bar.encoding: Common baseline for first segment; aligned totals.
stacked_bar.accessibility: Keep segment count low, label totals and distinguish segments without color alone.

pie_donut.label: Pie or donut chart
pie_donut.when: Show a simple whole split into a few mutually exclusive parts.
pie_donut.avoid: Many slices, negative values, close values, or time comparisons.
pie_donut.accessibility: Use direct labels and values; provide a table alternative; avoid 3D.

scatter.label: Scatter plot
scatter.when: Inspect association, clusters, outliers or correlation between two numeric variables.
scatter.avoid: Ordinal categories or claims of causation from correlation.
scatter.accessibility: Label axes, disclose scale and units, use shape or outlines alongside color.

histogram.label: Histogram
histogram.when: Show the shape of a numeric distribution using bins.
histogram.avoid: Comparing unrelated bin definitions or using category labels.
histogram.accessibility: State bin width and whether the y-axis is count, proportion or density.

box_plot.label: Box plot
box_plot.when: Compare medians, spread and outliers across groups.
box_plot.avoid: Audiences unfamiliar with quartiles without explanation.
box_plot.accessibility: Define whisker convention and show sample size.

heatmap.label: Heatmap
heatmap.when: Reveal patterns in a two-dimensional matrix such as time by category.
heatmap.avoid: Precise lookup where labels and numbers are too small.
heatmap.accessibility: Use perceptually ordered palettes, visible cell values when practical, and non-color labels.

sankey.label: Sankey diagram
sankey.when: Show quantities moving between stages or destinations.
sankey.avoid: Too many crossing links or flows without measured quantities.
sankey.accessibility: Label nodes and values; provide a tabular flow list.

network.label: Network graph
network.when: Show entities and their connections when topology itself matters.
network.avoid: Dense hairballs or using proximity as a quantitative measure without explanation.
network.encoding: Nodes represent entities; edges represent relationships.
network.accessibility: Provide searchable node/edge data and a text summary.

treemap.label: Treemap
treemap.when: Show hierarchical parts-of-whole across many groups.
treemap.avoid: Precise comparison of similarly sized rectangles or deep hierarchies.
treemap.encoding: Rectangle area represents magnitude; nesting represents hierarchy.
treemap.accessibility: Label levels and values; provide a sortable table.

funnel.label: Funnel chart
funnel.when: Show measured stage counts through a sequential process.
funnel.avoid: Unordered categories or stages that are not nested.
funnel.encoding: Width represents remaining quantity by stage.
funnel.accessibility: Show stage values and conversion rates; do not imply proportionality if widths are decorative.

map.label: Choropleth or symbol map
map.when: Show geographically anchored values or events.
map.avoid: Data with no meaningful location or misleading area comparisons.
map.encoding: Color by normalized rate or symbol size by quantity.
map.accessibility: Name regions, state units and normalization, and provide a ranked table.

small_multiples.label: Small multiples
small_multiples.when: Compare repeated patterns across groups without overlapping series.
small_multiples.avoid: Inconsistent axes when direct comparison is intended.
small_multiples.encoding: Same chart repeated with shared scales.
small_multiples.accessibility: Keep scales consistent or clearly mark differences; title each panel.

kpi.label: KPI indicator
kpi.when: Communicate one key value with target, context and change.
kpi.avoid: A naked number without timeframe, units or comparison.
kpi.encoding: Value plus reference target or prior period.
kpi.accessibility: Include metric definition, period, units and direction semantics.

rules: Choose the encoding from the analytical question, not visual novelty.
Use line charts for continuous time; bars for category comparisons.
Do not use pie or donut charts for many categories or close values.
Avoid 3D charts, truncated magnitude axes, dual axes without strong justification, and decorative chart junk.
Use colorblind-safe palettes and never encode a category by color alone.
Show units, time window, source, sample size and uncertainty when relevant.
Provide a table or text summary for complex or accessibility-critical charts.
Keep data separate from chart configuration and validate schemas before rendering.
Treat generated chart images as presentation assets, not substitutes for accessible interactive charts when users need exploration.
